source.citation: Hamer, W. J., Wu, Y.-C. (1972). Osmotic coefficients and mean activity coefficients of uni-univalent electrolytes in water at 25 C. Journal of Physical and Chemical Reference Data 1, 1047-1100.

transcription.from: the published article (PDF), Table 16, p. 1067, read on the page image
transcription.note: Ten of these rows were typed in test/published_values.jl before this file existed and agree with the table. The text layer of the scan reads the saturated molality as 6.1448: it is 6.144 followed by the note mark a.

nacl_saturated_molality.description: Molality of the saturated NaCl solution, the last row of the table.

nacl_saturated_phi.description: Osmotic coefficient of the saturated solution.

nacl_saturated_gamma.description: Mean activity coefficient of the saturated solution.

notes: Osmotic coefficient phi and mean activity coefficient gamma of aqueous NaCl at 25 C, a critical compilation of many measurements; the saturated solution is kept apart, as quantities.
